fields.name: Shard key type metadata
fields.definition: A compact code for the .NET types of a shard key's record-key columns, embedded in every serialized shard key: binary, UTF-8 and the external key. Deserializing checks it against the expected generic types, so bytes produced for one key shape cannot be read as another. It also lets a ghost shard key reconstruct a key whose types are unknown at compile time. It identifies key *types*, not tables: keys of the same types from different tables are indistinguishable. In older documentation it replaces the per-table DataOrigin character.
